title: search-api v4.12
text: Rolled out search-api v4.12 to production (canary 10% at 16:05, full at 17:30 UTC). Changes: cross-encoder ranking now serves all search traffic, reranker v2 flag default on (PR 1187); bumps the protobuf library; drops the unused legacy facets endpoint. Canary checks passed on error rate. Rollback plan: previous image v4.11.3.
